card.name: Words just before 'independence' in history
card.fires_on: Small linking words (after, of, from, for, to) in history text about colonies, where the next word is likely 'independence'. It also fires on a year in decolonization narratives.

modes.label: Link before independence
modes.description: A preposition or verb right before the word independence, about a country breaking from colonial rule.

modes.label: Struggle or separation phrasing
modes.description: Words like for or from after struggle, fight or independence, in colonial history.
modes.example: five years after Greece began its fight<< for>> independence, the Janizaries revolted

modes.label: Year in colonial history
modes.description: A year digit in a passage about a colony's late colonial period.

card.writes: It pushes toward the words independence and autonomy, in several languages, and away from unrelated technical words.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a likely 'independence' in texts about countries leaving colonial rule.
